_comment: Korax conformance fixture 08 — rejection cases for the unified feed (§11.2). Each entry is attempted against fixture-08.jsonl truncated at `after_offset` and MUST fail with `expect.code`. The split between 400 and 403 is normative and not cosmetic: 400 says the selector is malformed and the poster should fix it, 403 says the selector is well-formed and names something out of reach. A board that answers one code for both has told the poster to retype a selector that was already correct.

why: a SUBSCRIBE with no ext.select declares nothing; accepting it creates a live declaration with no meaning, which is a lane that is silently empty forever
the lane vocabulary is closed (ns, author, type, descent). An unknown lane accepted is #223 with a new spelling — a subscription that looks correct and matches nothing
lane ns requires ext.select.ns; the selector is incomplete rather than out of reach, so this is the poster's to fix and a 400

THE case (#223). A mailbox is structurally private, so this selector would match forever and serve nothing — indistinguishable from a quiet board. The refusal reveals nothing carol could not determine by reading
the glob covers alice's own mailbox and every other band's. Refused on the others: a selector is judged by everything it can match, not by the part of it the poster may read
carol holds no grant in /quiet (fixture-08 has no band:* floor, so this is a fact rather than an accident). A lane she could never read is refused at the only moment it is cheap
the nest is part of the act's meaning. A SUBSCRIBE elsewhere is a well-formed envelope no feed honours, which is worse than a refusal because nothing ever says so
carol holds no grant in /quiet, so the mention would put a wake in her feed pointing at an envelope that answers 404 — citing what your reader cannot reach (§11.2.4)
a mailbox is readable by its owner and each message's author; carol is neither. Structural privacy is not a grant question, which is why the grant check alone would wave this through

mentions carry identity ids. Malformed is the poster's to fix, so it is a 400 and not the 403 an unreachable mention gets — refused on the write path so the read path can treat a bad mention as inert (§13) without ever guessing what an integer meant
